cat > /app/tmp/test_ipv6.py <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys, pathlib, os
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/app/tmp/ipv6-tests'); ROOT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
SCRIPT='/app/submission/ipv6_replay.py'
def run(args, ok=True):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,SCRIPT,*map(str,args)],capture_output=True)
 if ok:
  assert r.returncode==0,(args,r.returncode,r.stderr[:1000]); assert not r.stderr
  return json.loads(r.stdout)
 assert r.returncode==2 and not r.stdout and r.stderr,(args,r.returncode,r.stdout[:100],r.stderr[:100])

def manifest(**kw):
 d=dict(version=1,seed=0,low_count=2,attempts=3,spacing_ms=10,timeout_ms=100,
        windows=[dict(id='w',start_ms=1000,scopes=[dict(id='s',prefix='2001:db8:1:0::/64',subnets=[0])])])
 d.update(kw); return d
m=manifest(); mp=ROOT/'m.json'; mp.write_text(json.dumps(m))
p=run(['plan',mp]); byid={x['id']:x for x in p['probes']}
def row(pid,attempt_time=None,target=None,source=None,type=129,code=0):
 x=byid[pid] if pid in byid else p['probes'][0]
 return dict(probe_id=pid,received_ms=x['sent_ms'] if attempt_time is None else attempt_time,
             target=x['target'] if target is None else target,
             source=x['target'] if source is None else source,type=type,code=code)
# Evidence: internal low1/low2; low1 error sourced at low2 -> overlap low2.
t1='2001:db8:1::1'; t2='2001:db8:1::2'; outside='2001:db8:ffff::a'
rows=[]
rows.append(row('w/s/0/low-1/0',source=t1,type=129,code=0))
rows.append(row('w/s/0/low-1/1',source=t2,type=1,code=6))
rows.append(row('w/s/0/low-1/2',source=t1,type=1,code=1)) # anomaly, responsive
rows.append(row('w/s/0/low-2/0',source=outside,type=129,code=0)) # anomaly
rows.append(row('w/s/0/low-2/1',source=t2,type=129,code=0))
# canary 0 hits; canary 1 only wrong-source echo and an error, so no hit
c0=byid['w/s/0/canary-0/2']; c1=byid['w/s/0/canary-1/0']
rows.append(row(c0['id'],source=c0['target']))
rows.append(row(c1['id'],source=outside))
rows.append(row('w/s/0/canary-1/1',source=outside,type=1,code=0))
# Dedup spelling/key order variant of first row.
rows.append(dict(code=0,type=129,source='2001:0DB8:0001:0000:0000:0000:0000:0001',
                 target='2001:0DB8:0001:0000:0000:0000:0000:0001',received_ms=1000,
                 probe_id='w/s/0/low-1/0'))
rp=ROOT/'r.jsonl'; rp.write_text('\n'.join(json.dumps(x) for x in rows)+'\n')
r=run(['replay',mp,rp])
assert (r['accepted_rows'],r['duplicate_rows'])==(8,1),r
s=r['segments'][0]
assert s['state']=='ambiguous' and s['exposure']=='excluded' and s['canary_hits']==[0],s
assert s['internal']==[t1,t2] and s['external']==[t2] and s['overlap']==[t2],s
x,y=s['targets']
assert x['classification']==y['classification']=='ambiguous'
assert x['internal_attempts']==[0] and x['external_attempts']==[1] and x['silent_attempts']==[],x
assert y['internal_attempts']==[1] and y['external_attempts']==[] and y['silent_attempts']==[2],y
# Both canaries hit takes precedence over overlap.
more=[row('w/s/0/canary-1/2',source=byid['w/s/0/canary-1/2']['target'])]
rp.write_text('\n'.join(json.dumps(x) for x in rows[:-1]+more)+'\n')
r=run(['replay',mp,rp]); s=r['segments'][0]
assert s['state']=='alias_suspect' and s['exposure']=='excluded' and s['canary_hits']==[0,1]
assert all(x['classification']=='alias_suspect' for x in s['targets'])
# Quarantine precedence.
bad=[]
bad.append(b'\n') # json
bad.append(b'{bad}\n') # json
bad.append((json.dumps(dict(probe_id='x',received_ms=1,target='bad',source='bad',type=1))+'\n').encode()) # schema
bad.append((json.dumps(dict(probe_id='x',received_ms=1,target='bad',source='bad',type=1,code=0))+'\n').encode()) # address
bad.append((json.dumps(row('x',target=t1,source=t1))+'\n').encode()) # unknown
bad.append((json.dumps(row('w/s/0/low-1/0',target=t2,source=t1,attempt_time=0,type=99))+'\n').encode()) # mismatch
bad.append((json.dumps(row('w/s/0/low-1/0',attempt_time=0,type=99))+'\n').encode()) # time
bad.append((json.dumps(row('w/s/0/low-1/0',type=99))+'\n').encode()) # icmp
bad.append((json.dumps(dict(probe_id='',received_ms=1,target=t1,source=t1,type=1,code=0))+'\n').encode()) # schema
bad.append(b'\xef\xbb\xbf{}\n') # json BOM
bad.append(b'{"probe_id":"x","probe_id":"y"}\n') # json duplicate
bad.append(b'{"x":NaN}\n') # json constant
rp.write_bytes(b''.join(bad))
r=run(['replay',mp,rp])
assert [x['reason'] for x in r['diagnostics']]==['json','json','schema','address','unknown_probe','target_mismatch','time','icmp','schema','json','json','json'],r
assert r['accepted_rows']==r['duplicate_rows']==0
# Empty log and CRLF are valid.
rp.write_bytes(b''); r=run(['replay',mp,rp]); assert r['accepted_rows']==0 and not r['diagnostics']
rp.write_bytes((json.dumps(row('w/s/0/low-1/0'))+'\r\n').encode()); r=run(['replay',mp,rp]); assert r['accepted_rows']==1
# Whole-file errors.
rp.write_bytes(b'x'*4097); run(['replay',mp,rp],False)
rp.write_bytes(b'x'*4096); run(['replay',mp,rp],False) # valid length, but two physical lines because read cap? must not happen
PY
